value.rationale: The Clebsch graph is a canonical exceptional 16-vertex Ramsey and strongly regular graph. A complete affine symmetry action on its natural independence-complex third homology reveals two irreducible module types, the distinction between translation-trivial and translation-sensitive cycles, every possible automorphism trace, and absence of full symmetry invariants. These data are not implied by nine-sphere homotopy type or independence polynomial and are natural input for equivariant topological combinatorics.
